create_spacy_tokenizer_basic: create a SpacyTokenizer instance with the default English spaCy model and no annotators
create_spacy_tokenizer_with_annotators: create a SpacyTokenizer with pos, lemma, and ner annotators enabled for rich token annotations
tokenize_text_with_spacy: tokenize a string of text using SpacyTokenizer to get tokens with whitespace and character offsets
tokenize_with_ner_and_lemma: tokenize text with named entity recognition and lemmatization enabled via the annotators argument
review_spacy_tokenizer_class: review the SpacyTokenizer class to understand how it loads spaCy models and processes tokens
